title: SQLite recursive CTEs
contribution: Recursive CTEs traverse trees/graphs in ordinary relational storage
boundary: Traversal viability does not imply every relationship should be stored

title: SQLite FTS5
contribution: Full-text search can live in same database and be rebuilt as projection/index
boundary: FTS is search infrastructure, not canonical claim truth

title: SQLite STRICT tables
contribution: Stronger type discipline is available while retaining SQLite simplicity
boundary: STRICT does not replace application invariants or migrations

title: SQLite WAL documentation
contribution: WAL permits readers with a writer but requires same-machine shared memory; long readers can cause checkpoint starvation
boundary: Use local attached storage, bounded writes/read lifetimes and explicit checkpoint policy

title: SQLite foreign key documentation
contribution: Foreign-key enforcement is enabled per connection and historically defaults off unless explicitly requested
boundary: Every canonical connection must bootstrap and verify FK enforcement

title: SQLite Online Backup API
contribution: Backup API produces a consistent snapshot of a live database
boundary: Do not back up a live database by copying only the main file

title: SQLite release/change history
contribution: 2026 releases include WAL-related corruption/deadlock fixes, showing version choice is an operational invariant
boundary: Pin and test a minimum supported SQLite version instead of relying on arbitrary system SQLite
